subject: Crestwood RFP: resilience / controls questionnaire
messages:
From: Lisa Tran <ltran@crestwoodbank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: RFP: resilience controls questionnaire - initial ask

Jordan,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our vendor diligence for our next-gen lending platform we need a completed resilience / FFIEC-style controls questionnaire. The procurement timeline is tight — we need your completed responses and evidence by COB Nov 22.

Key asks:
- High-level mapping to FFIEC domains (BCP, third-party, incident response, change mgmt)
- SOC 2 Type II or equivalent attestation and test dates
- Encryption at-rest/in-transit and KMS/HSM details
- Data residency and retention controls, including audit logs and retention windows
- Expected RTO/RPO for hosted, dedicated, and private deployment options

I've attached the Excel questionnaire (crestwood_rfp_resilience_questions.xlsx). Please let me know if you need a call to walk through. Also copy in procurement (Mark) on any pricing/SLA exceptions.

Best,
Lisa
Lisa Tran
VP, Vendor Risk Management
Crestwood Community Bank
[Attachment: crestwood_rfp_resilience_questions.xlsx (xlsx, 240KB)]
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Tran <ltran@crestwoodbank.com>
Cc: Mark Bennett <mbennett@crestwoodbank.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: RFP: resilience controls questionnaire - initial ask

Hi Lisa —

Appreciate the send and the timeline. We can meet the Nov 22 deadline but will need a short internal response window to assemble evidence. Neha (security) and Marcus (platform) are cc'd — I'll coordinate.

Quick notes:
- We have a SOC 2 Type II (report year 2025) and can provide the report and selective control evidence (audit logs, user provisioning).
- Hosted, Dedicated, Private (VPC & on-prem) deployment options have different RTO/RPO expectations; I'll include a concise table.
- We support KMS integrations (customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM) for Private and Dedicated; hosted customers may use Redwood-managed keys with optional BYOK.

I'll aim to get a draft response to you by Nov 18 so you have time for review before your Nov 22 deadline. Do you want a 30-min walkthrough after you review?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:07:00 -05:00
Subject: Fwd: Crestwood RFP - resilience questionnaire (please own parts)

Folks — forwarding Crestwood's questionnaire (attached). Rapid turnaround request: they want evidence by 11/22; I'll draft and circulate by 11/18. Can you please take ownership of the blocks below?

Neha — SOC 2/TAC controls, audit logs, retention policy, incident response runbooks. Can you pull the SOC2 report and a succinct control mapping (1–2 pages) and attach KMS/HSM details for private deployments?

Marcus — deployment topology, RTO/RPO per mode, encryption at-rest/in-transit specifics, KV cache and failover behavior, network isolation options, and architecture diagram. Crestwood asked specifically whether we support air-gapped on-prem installs and how DR works for dedicated pools.

Deliverables:
- SOC2 report stub + control mapping (neha)
- Architecture diagram + RTO/RPO table (marcus)
- Consolidated draft PDF response for Crestwood (I'll assemble)

Deadline to me: EOD Nov 16 so I can build and QA the draft by Nov 18. If any item is unclear, ping me and we can triage.

Thanks — Jordan
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:30:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Crestwood RFP - resilience questionnaire (please own parts)

Jordan / Marcus —

I've pulled the SOC 2 Type II (period 2025-04 to 2026-03) and the associated control narrative. Links and attachments below:
- redwood_soc2_type2_2025.pdf (redacted version)
- Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/crestwood/rfp-resilience-v1 (folder with evidence stubs)

Quick checklist of items I still need from product/infra:
1) Evidence of audit log retention configuration and export controls (log retention windows vary by deployment).
2) KMS/HSM integration runbook for Private installs (customer-managed HSM supported via PKCS#11).
3) Confirmation on encryption cipher suites in transit (we default to TLS1.3) and at-rest encryption algorithm/rotation cadence.
4) Disaster recovery test cadence and last DR test date for Dedicated pools.

On the capabilities: we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Dedicated and Private; we can integrate with AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, and on-prem HSMs. Private (on-prem) installations can be air-gapped but require an approval loop and a short professional services engagement for deployment.

I can produce a 2-page control mapping and a 1-page summary for legal/audit by Nov 16 EOD. Marcus, if you can confirm items 1–4 by tomorrow EOD I will slot them into the draft.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Lisa —

Attached is our consolidated draft response to the resilience questionnaire (crestwood_draft_response_v1.pdf). High-level highlights:
- SOC 2 Type II (report attached) and control mapping to FFIEC domains included.
- Summary table with RTO/RPO by deployment (hosted: P90 latency SLA, RTO ~15 min for control-plane failover; dedicated: RTO ~30–60 min depending on committed capacity; private: site-dependent, PS engagement required).
- KMS/HSM support: BYOK for dedicated/private; integration notes included.
- Audit logs: configurable retention windows (defaults listed) and export via secure transfer; we include retention policy links.

Attachments included: crestwood_draft_response_v1.pdf, redwood_soc2_type2_2025.pdf, kms-architecture-diagram.png.

Request: Please confirm receipt and let us know if you want a short call to walk the response. If the doc looks good, we'd appreciate feedback by Nov 22 to meet your timeline.

DocuSign: If you require an engagement letter for the Private deployment work we can send a DocuSign bundle — link included below.
